title: Graid
lines: In The Little Raid, Worm, Moth, Rock, Greg and Orphion are Graid: with 2 fielded, the first to fall gets back up a second later in its true form; with 3, every one does. Seqwawa, a new five-acorn healer, heals everyone and stands the last to fall back up.

Greg eats figures from your bench: drag one onto Feed Greg beside Sell, and he gains 2% health for each acorn of its price, up to 40%. Figures have names now, and kins and callings are origins and classes.
